params.body:
The academic proposals on the Sources page were forty of the machine's own concept labels at once ("ai authenticity disclosure paradox creator economy", "academic prestige prioritization"). A literature does not use those words, so the searches land anywhere, and forty lines at once is a wall: 32 have been waiting since 14 and 21 September.

- Only names a researcher could have written are proposed: four words at most, none of the machine's abstractions (paradox, normalization, optimization, prioritization, curation, infrastructure, economy and the like). "brainrot gaming vernacular" still qualifies; the compounds above do not.
- At most ten new proposals a run (`TW_ACADEMIC_PER_RUN`), instead of all forty.
- The line under a proposal says what a search finds now: "Seen in 258 signals. A search finds 10 recent papers; 8 of them study people (…)". The fit check from academic-fit.mjs was already there; this words it for the person approving.
- Test: `askable()` keeps short concrete names and drops the compounds. 986 tests pass.

The 32 proposals already waiting are not touched by the job (it never withdraws); they are to be dismissed on the Sources page.
params.title: Academic follow: ten askable proposals a week
